about: Calvin's taste graph. All 30 tracks of Calvin's Spotify playlist 'Fall Bangers' (read 2026-11-15 from Spotify's public pages, with the date each was added). Release dates and added dates are from Spotify's public pages; labels from Spotify's album pages (the phonographic copyright line). Tempo, key, frequency balance, dynamics and arrangement are measured by trackcard on the full track for 18 tracks; each track's measured_from says which. Style families are inferred (Claude's read).

nodes.name: Groove-led tech house
nodes.description: The 2024-26 club turn at 124-130 BPM: rolling, swung basslines, crisp percussion, sparse stabs and chopped vocal hooks; driving and playful, with little harmony or melody.

nodes.name: UK and soulful vocal house
nodes.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.

nodes.name: Disco, French touch and indie dance
nodes.description: Filtered disco loops, funk guitar and talkbox, French-touch pumping, and indie-dance remixes and re-edits at 120-126 BPM: bright, warm, joyful, with a song or a sample at the centre. New in Calvin's brain; Krish's graph files Purple Disco Machine-style tracks under uk_soulful_club's disco edge.

nodes.name: Afro and Latin club house
nodes.description: Afro house built for the club rather than the sunrise: log drums and congas, chanted or Latin vocal hooks, a firm four-to-the-floor at 120-124 BPM. New in Calvin's brain; harder and more driving than Krish's organic_afro_house.
